$comment: P69 round 1, fold f26c (lane cs): GNU `mode(M)` -- the declared type replaced by the type of a machine mode, from the C document's `machineModes` table. Until this fold the attribute was refused by name, and before that refusal `int x __attribute__((mode(DI)));` was a 4-byte object where gcc 13.3.0, clang 18.1.3, mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0, Apple clang and aarch64 gcc 13.3.0 all make it 8 (lane cs probes md and md2). Runnable so the BYTES are proven, not only the analyzer's sizes: QI arithmetic wraps at 256, a HI parameter is truncated at the call, DI holds past INT_MAX and 2^40, a member and an enumeration take the mode's size, SF and DF are float and double -- on every executable target, both pipelines. Only the modes every target has; XF and TF (the x87 and binary128 formats only some targets' C has) are the unit pins'. Exit 42 = every check held; another code names the first check that did not.
